must_reads.title: LycheeMemory V2: Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents via Semantic Segment-Level Consolidation

method_explanation.purpose: Long-horizon LLM agents must preserve information from past interactions to support future tasks.
method_explanation.approach: Existing memory systems typically rely on eager consolidation, invoking LLMs after each interaction to extract, summarize, or update memories.
method_explanation.difference: This design makes memory construction increasingly costly as conversations grow.

must_reads.title: AutoDesign: Meta-Harness Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Design

method_explanation.purpose: Transforming multimodal sources into condensed and structured media outputs can be fundamentally conceptualized as a long-horizon agentic process centered on a model-harness system.
method_explanation.approach: While an ideal harness system should align with human design priors and accumulate reusable experience through empirical exploration to drive recursive self-improvement, existing paradigms remain static and fall short of this capability.
method_explanation.difference: In this paper, we present AutoDesign, a framework that aligns with human design priors, where a meta-harness optimizer guides a code agent to recursively improve harness based on rollout feedback.

must_reads.title: MegaParts: Scaling Part-Aware 3D Object Generation to 300 Parts via Token-Efficient Autoregressive Modeling

method_explanation.purpose: Part-aware 3D object generation is essential for graphics applications such as controllable modeling, editing, and articulation, where objects are represented as coherent assemblies of semantic parts.
method_explanation.approach: However, existing part-aware generation methods, do not scale well to highly complex objects.
method_explanation.difference: As the number of parts increases, generating detailed geometry becomes prohibitively expensive in token length and memory.

method_explanation.purpose: The world evolves following its dynamics, i.e., its laws of motion.
method_explanation.approach: However, leading video diffusion models largely fit the pixels without modeling how the pixels transit over time.
method_explanation.difference: Thus, they render visually plausible frames but may not accurately obey the laws.

must_reads.title: ReRound: Reconstructive Rounding to Resolve Midpoint Ambiguity in Calibration-Free LLM Quantization

method_explanation.purpose: ReRound (Reconstructive Rounding) is a post-training quantization method that addresses the midpoint ambiguity inherent in standard round-to-nearest (RTN) schemes when quantizing weights near the centers of quantization intervals.
method_explanation.approach: Starting from a pretrained LLM, ReRound trains a conditional diffusion model to produce continuous reconstructions of low-bit weights for the LLM.
method_explanation.difference: These reconstructed weights act as a guidance signal to disambiguate the rounding direction of weights located close to interval midpoints.
